tokens.name: ultramarine
tokens.usage: Lazurite, the blue of lapis lazuli (S Kα 2.31 keV). The colour that leads the energy reading: Fingerprint covers, the avatar, the first slide of a Fingerprint carousel. Lead white type on it holds 8.5:1. Vermilion on it is 2.0:1 and vibrates on purpose: shapes only, never type.

tokens.name: ultramarine-deep
tokens.usage: A second ultramarine sheet laid on an ultramarine ground, like a darker glaze. Lead white type on it holds 11.1:1.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Cinnabar, mercury sulfide (Hg Lα 9.99 keV): the accent. One vermilion element per composition: the strongest line of a fingerprint, one word, one disc. As type only at 66px and up on gesso (4.0:1) or black (3.6:1); white type on vermilion holds 4.8:1.

tokens.name: vermilion-deep
tokens.usage: A second vermilion sheet on a vermilion ground. White type on it holds 6.2:1.

tokens.name: gesso
tokens.usage: Gypsum ground (Ca Kα 3.69 keV), the preparation every panel painting starts on. It leads the depth reading: Pentimento covers. Also the reading ground: documents, the website, art slides and every closing slide. Bone black type on it holds 14.3:1.

tokens.name: lead-white
tokens.usage: Lead white (Pb Lα 10.55 keV). Type and lines on ultramarine (8.5:1) and black (15.3:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Type on vermilion (4.8:1); a sheet laid on gesso for depth by overlap (1.2:1, decoration only).

tokens.name: bone-black
tokens.usage: Charred bone, calcium phosphate and carbon (Ca Kα 3.69 keV). The instrument ground for spectra and maps, and the ink on gesso (14.3:1).

tokens.name: bone-deep
tokens.usage: A second sheet laid on a black ground. Decoration only (1.2:1).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary text on gesso (5.1:1).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text on black (6.8:1).

tokens.name: lapis-light
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ultramarine (6.2:1).

tokens.name: line-gesso
tokens.usage: Construction on gesso. Decoration only (1.2:1).

tokens.name: line-ultramarine
tokens.usage: Construction on ultramarine. Decoration only (1.4:1).

tokens.name: line-black
tokens.usage: Construction on black. Decoration only (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-vermilion
tokens.usage: Construction on vermilion. Decoration only (1.4:1).

tokens.name: fe-ochre
tokens.usage: Yellow ochre, iron oxide-hydroxide (Fe Kα 6.40 keV). Iron's colour in spectra and maps: on black (6.3:1) and ultramarine (3.5:1), never on gesso (2.3:1). Never as a band touching vermilion.

tokens.name: cu-azurite
tokens.usage: Azurite, basic copper carbonate (Cu Kα 8.05 keV). Copper's colour in spectra and maps on gesso (4.8:1) and black (3.0:1).

tokens.name: cu-verdigris
tokens.usage: Verdigris, copper acetate (Cu Kα 8.05 keV). Copper's colour when the subject is a green; on black (3.9:1) and gesso (3.7:1), shapes only.

tokens.name: au-gold
tokens.usage: Gold leaf (Au Lα 9.71 keV). Gold's colour in spectra and maps on black (5.4:1); in print, a real gold foil instead.

tokens.name: varnish
tokens.usage: Aged natural resin varnish, the top stratum of a cross-section. Organic: no lines in the window; ultraviolet light shows it. Strata only. Bone black type on it holds 8.1:1.

tokens.name: gesso-layer
tokens.usage: The gesso stratum of a cross-section, a shade deeper than the gesso ground so the two never merge (1.2:1 against it, decoration only). Strata only. Bone black type on it holds 11.9:1.

tokens.name: bole
tokens.usage: Bole, the red iron-rich clay laid between the gesso and the gold leaf (Fe Kα 6.40 keV). Strata only. White type on it holds 6.3:1.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The wooden support, poplar or oak, the bottom stratum of a panel section. Organic: no lines in the window. Strata only. Bone black type on it holds 5.6:1.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The composition's ground, set by its theme.

tokens.name: figure
tokens.usage: Type, lines, the axis and the logo on `ground`: 8.5:1 on ultramarine, 14.3:1 on gesso, 15.3:1 on black, 4.8:1 on vermilion.

tokens.name: figure-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary type and labels at any size: 6.2:1 on ultramarine, 5.1:1 on gesso, 6.8:1 on black, 4.8:1 on vermilion.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one vermilion element: the tallest line of a fingerprint, the probe of a cross-section, one word at 66px and up, one disc. On ultramarine it vibrates (2.0:1) and stays a shape; on a vermilion ground the accent is bone black (3.6:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Type on an `accent` fill: white on vermilion (4.8:1), white on bone black (17.2:1).

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A second sheet laid over `ground`; depth comes from overlap, never from shadows. Same type rules as its ground.

tokens.name: construction
tokens.usage: Grid guides, ticks and dimension lines under the composition. Decoration only; values are written in `label`.

families.grotesk: "TeX Gyre Heros", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.condensed: "TeX Gyre Heros Cn", "Helvetica Neue", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
families.mono: "Fragment Mono", "TeX Gyre Heros", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Art voice
groups.note: EB Garamond, a Renaissance roman after Claude Garamont. The voice of art, materials, history and people; the Innova of the logo. Sizes are canvas px on the 1080-wide post, from Le Corbusier's Modulor; leading locks to the 40px baseline in steps of 20.

styles.name: art-l
styles.usage: Art covers: two to four words, sentence case. Italic for the one word that turns the line.

styles.name: art-m
styles.usage: Art statements: one sentence, one slide.

styles.name: pigment
styles.usage: The name of a pigment or a material, always beside its formula in `data` and its line in `label`.

styles.name: aside
styles.sample: Can you see yourself inside an accelerator?
styles.usage: The one question under a headline, in either voice. Never more than two lines.

styles.name: legend
styles.usage: Pigment, material and work names at text size: legends under a spectrum, the name beside a `label`. Lowercase unless a proper name.

groups.name: Science voice
groups.note: TeX Gyre Heros, the TeX Users Group's free Helvetica, and its condensed cut: the voice of the machine, numbers and processes; the Physics of the logo. Cuts named by Univers code: 55 regular, 65 bold, 67 bold condensed.

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: Cut 67. One to three words in capitals; may bleed off the right edge as the one kick.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Cut 65. The number of a datum, with its unit in `data` and its status in `label`.

styles.name: headline-l
styles.usage: Cut 65. Machine covers, two to four words, sentence case.

styles.name: headline-m
styles.usage: Cut 65. Statements about the machine: one sentence, one slide.

styles.name: headline-s
styles.usage: Cut 65. Section and list titles; the smallest size `accent` type may take.

styles.name: column
styles.usage: Cut 67. Capitals stacked up a column: the fingerprint covers.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Running text is Heros 55 in both registers. Flush left, ragged right, never justified, never centred, except the logos of the closing slide.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We design and build an open-hardware, tabletop electron linear accelerator.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a headline, two to four lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mercury answers the beam at 9.99 keV.
styles.usage: Running text on a post, one line per baseline.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Notes, sources and credits. The smallest size on a post.

groups.name: Instrument
groups.note: Fragment Mono, a monospaced Helvetica built from the same Nimbus Sans as Heros: axes, readings, labels, units. It has no Greek: α, β, γ and Ω fall back to Heros, the same skeleton, so Hg Lα sets as written.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, figure numbers, element symbols, line names, statuses and axis values. Type the capitals in the text itself, never by transform: element symbols, line names and units keep their case (FIG. 01 · Hg Lα 9.99 keV).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Formulas and readings beside a `numeral` or a `pigment`.

tokens.name: unit
tokens.usage: The base unit. Every length is a whole number of units.

tokens.name: half-baseline
tokens.usage: Leading step for display sizes; small offsets.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: The baseline of posts and slides; also the gutter.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Between columns and rows, on posts and slides.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Canvas edge to the live area: top, left and right of a post; all four sides of a slide.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: One square field of the post grid (six columns by eight rows).

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: One field plus one gutter.

tokens.name: signature-zone
tokens.usage: The band under the post grid (y 1320 to 1440). On a cover: the logo carrying this post's fingerprint, 64px tall from column 1. On inner slides: the slide count in `label` at column 6. Empty on the closing slide. On a Pentimento cover the strata stop at its top edge.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: The one line every post shares, at y 860: the energy axis on Fingerprint posts, where spectra rise above it; the painting's surface on Pentimento posts, where the strata hang below it; the beam on machine posts. Every cover keeps it at this height, so the profile grid draws one continuous line.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Slide edge to content on every side.

tokens.name: slide-column
tokens.usage: One of twelve slide columns (12 × 110 + 11 × 40 + 2 × 80 = 1920).

tokens.name: slide-axis
tokens.usage: The shared line on 16:9 slides.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every block, sheet, frame, bar and label box.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: True circles only: a particle, a beam spot, the avatar crop.

stroke.note: Line weights in canvas px; each doubles the last.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Construction, ticks, dimension lines and the boundaries between strata.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Rules, the energy axis of a spectrum, the painting's surface, and the strokes of tratteggio.

tokens.name: stroke-beam
tokens.usage: The beam, the probe, and the lines of a fingerprint at post scale.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: Fingerprint lines and lattice outlines at poster scale.

spectrum.note: The fingerprint programme: emission-line energies in keV from the X-ray Data Booklet (LBNL), table 1-2, in energy order. Drawn heights are rounded design values, not measured intensities.

tokens.name: energy-min
tokens.usage: Left end of every fingerprint's energy window, in keV.

tokens.name: energy-max
tokens.usage: Right end of the window, in keV. Lines outside it are not drawn.

tokens.name: line-al-ka
tokens.usage: Aluminium Kα, keV: ultramarine, clays.

tokens.name: line-si-ka
tokens.usage: Silicon Kα, keV: ultramarine, smalt, glass, earths.

tokens.name: line-s-ka
tokens.usage: Sulfur Kα, keV: ultramarine, vermilion.

tokens.name: line-ca-ka
tokens.usage: Calcium Kα, keV: gesso, chalk, bone black.

tokens.name: line-cr-ka
tokens.usage: Chromium Kα, keV: chrome yellow, viridian, stainless steel.

tokens.name: line-fe-ka
tokens.usage: Iron Kα, keV: ochres, earths, steel.

tokens.name: line-fe-kb
tokens.usage: Iron Kβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-ni-ka
tokens.usage: Nickel Kα, keV: stainless steel.

tokens.name: line-cu-ka
tokens.usage: Copper Kα, keV: azurite, malachite, verdigris, every conductor.

tokens.name: line-w-la
tokens.usage: Tungsten Lα, keV: the cathode of the electron source.

tokens.name: line-cu-kb
tokens.usage: Copper Kβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-w-lb
tokens.usage: Tungsten Lβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-au-la
tokens.usage: Gold Lα, keV: gilding.

tokens.name: line-hg-la
tokens.usage: Mercury Lα, keV: vermilion.

tokens.name: line-pb-la
tokens.usage: Lead Lα, keV: lead white, red lead, lead-tin yellow.

tokens.name: line-w-lg
tokens.usage: Tungsten Lγ, keV.

tokens.name: line-au-lb
tokens.usage: Gold Lβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-hg-lb
tokens.usage: Mercury Lβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-pb-lb
tokens.usage: Lead Lβ, keV.

tokens.name: line-hg-lg
tokens.usage: Mercury Lγ, keV.

tokens.name: line-pb-lg
tokens.usage: Lead Lγ, keV.

canvas.note: Formats. Posts and slides in px; print in mm.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: The width of every post format.

tokens.name: canvas-3x4
tokens.usage: Default post and carousel height: the 3:4 profile-grid tile.

tokens.name: canvas-4x5
tokens.usage: LinkedIn at 1080 wide and older 4:5 posts.

tokens.name: canvas-story
tokens.usage: Stories and reels (9:16). Keep type out of the top and bottom 240px.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: The 16:9 slide and video canvas.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Height of the 16:9 canvas.

tokens.name: poster-f4-width
tokens.usage: Weltformat F4, the Swiss street poster (895 × 1280 mm).

tokens.name: poster-f4-height
tokens.usage: Height of the Weltformat poster.

tokens.name: poster-a0-width
tokens.usage: A0 conference posters.

tokens.name: poster-a0-height
tokens.usage: Height of the A0 poster.
